jars: Better your own path, imperfectly walked, than someone else's done perfectly.
The quiet one everyone relies on often matters most.
best: You sent out your applications. You are making flat whites. These are your hands and your work right now. Do this work that fits you, imperfectly, as an offering. It is enough.
day1_verdict: It actually gets the specific ache of seeing everyone else ahead while you're stuck making coffee, but the language feels a bit too polished and philosophical for how I'm actually feeling right now.
